title: Credit Limits, Limit Increases and Review Cycles by Terms Tier — Commercial Credit Account
content:
The credit limit figures of a Commercial Credit Account are set by its terms tier. Amounts are in USD.

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent credit limit floor | 2500.00 | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 75000.00 | 250000.00 | 1000000.00 |
| Permanent credit limit ceiling | 9999.00 | 49999.00 | 149999.00 | 499999.00 | 2499999.00 | 15000000.00 |
| Over-limit tolerance, percent above the credit limit | 0 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 15 |
| Largest temporary increase, percent of the permanent limit | 0 | 10 | 15 | 20 | 25 | 30 |
| Longest temporary increase, calendar days from the decision date | 0 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 90 |
| Largest permanent step in one review, percent of the current permanent limit | 25 | 25 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 100 |
| Minimum months since the last credit review | 6 | 6 | 6 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Minimum trailing-12-month on-time payment percentage | 90 | 90 | 90 | 85 | 85 | 80 |
| Largest increase the credit desk approves without committee referral | 2500.00 | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 | 100000.00 | 250000.00 |
| Business days to decide a limit review request | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Months between periodic credit reviews | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 6 | 6 |

### Definitions carried by the schedule

1. **Floor** — the lowest permanent credit limit the tier can carry.
2. **Ceiling** — the highest permanent credit limit the tier can carry; a higher limit requires a tier change.
3. **Over-limit tolerance** — the percent above the credit limit that open receivable may reach before the account is treated as over limit.
4. **Temporary increase** — the largest temporary credit limit increase (plant shutdown, turnaround or seasonal build), as a percent of the permanent limit, and its longest duration in calendar days from the decision date; 0 means not offered.
5. **Largest permanent step** — the largest permanent limit increase granted in one review, percent of the current permanent limit.
6. **Minimum months since review** — minimum whole calendar months since the account's last credit review before a new limit increase request is decided.
7. **Minimum on-time percentage** — the minimum trailing-12-month on-time payment percentage required to approve a permanent limit increase.
8. **Desk approval amount** — the largest increase amount (new limit minus current limit) the credit desk approves without a credit committee referral.
9. **Decision days** — business days within which a limit review request is decided.
10. **Review cycle** — months between scheduled periodic credit reviews of the account.

### Points of judgement

- The Corbett Net 10 Starter Account shows 0 for both temporary-increase lines: it does not offer a temporary increase.
- The Corbett Net 10 Starter Account shows an over-limit tolerance of 0: any receivable above its credit limit is over limit.
- *Hypothetical:* on a tier with a 5 percent tolerance, an account with a credit limit of 20000.00 is over limit once its receivable exceeds 21000.00; at exactly 21000.00 it is not.
